name: Korg prologue
description: Korg prologue-8 and prologue-16, every control change in their MIDI Implementation.

sources.title: prologue MIDI Implementation (Revision 1.01, 2020.2.10)
sources.notes: Tables read by tools/profiles/korg/read-korg-text.mjs from prologue_MIDIImp.txt (sha256 2b9820ff1c077b721083fe473f55e888aa78286e125b443a28bfe6be45185c61), https://www.korg.com/us/support/download/manual/0/778/4066/. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/korg/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/korg/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a control change the document says the instrument recognises, or a row of its NRPN table, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Pull reads the program-wide settings and TIMBRE 1, taken to be the main timbre: the document numbers the two timbres and does not say which is main. With the sub timbre selected by TIMBRE EDIT, the controllers move the sub timbre, which Pull does not read.
MOD EFFECT SUB TYPE (CC 96), DELAY/REVERB SUB TYPE (CC 97) and MULTI SUB TYPE SELECT (CC 103) depend on the type chosen beside them, so they are numbers with their lists in the description.
CC 88 (MOD EFFECT TYPE) is a number: the document's receive and transmit tables disagree on its values (5-14, 2-14).
Not a parameter here, Bank Select, part of preset recall: CC 0, 32.
Not a parameter here, a channel mode message: CC 120, 122, 123.

Pull: CURRENT PROGRAM DATA DUMP REQUEST, answered by the current program in Korg's 8-in-7 packing (384Bytes (7bit) -> 336Bytes (8bit)). 44 parameter(s) are read back from it by the program table's offsets; a controller parameter reads the top seven bits of its 10-bit field, the value its controller sends.

Two-byte values are read low byte first, the earlier byte holding the low eight bits: the prologue document's own TEMPO settles it (300~6000 as H:0~7 then L:0~4), and the miniKORG 700Sm's document, which prints L first, agrees.
The exclusive header carries the global MIDI channel as 3g; the profile's deviceId variable is that byte, 30H for channel 1.

In the program dump but not read back: MOD EFFECT TYPE (the dump holds 0 - 4 where the parameter is 0 - 127); DELAY/REVERB TYPE (the dump names a value "OFF" the parameter has no choice for); RING-SYNC (the dump names a value "RING ON" the parameter has no choice for); MULTI TYPE (the dump names a value "USER" the parameter has no choice for).

Not found under its own name in the program dump, so not read back: TIMBRE BALANCE, MULTI SHAPE, DAMPER, PITCH EG, TIMBRE EDIT, MOD EFFECT SUB TYPE, DELAY/REVERB SUB TYPE, MULTI SUB TYPE SELECT, MULTI SHIFT SHAPE.

In the program dump with no parameter of the same name here: OCTAVE, SUB ON/PGM FETCH, EDIT TIMBRE, MAIN/SUB BALANCE, MAIN/SUB POSITION, SPLIT POINT, TEMPO, ARP TARGET, CATEGORY, FREQUENT UPPER, FREQUENT LOWER, AMP VELOCITY, PORTAMENTO MODE, PROGRAM LEVEL, MOD EFFECT CHORUS, MOD EFFECT ENSEMBLE, MOD EFFECT PHASER, MOD EFFECT FLANGER, MOD EFFECT USER, MICRO TUNING, SCALE KEY, PROGRAM TUNING, PROGRAM TRANSPOSE, ARP GATE TIME, ARP RATE, REVERB TYPE, DELAY TYPE, MOD EFFECT ROUTING, DELAY/REVERB ROUTING, ARPEGGIATOR, ARPEGGIATOR RANGE, ARPEGGIATOR TYPE, LIKE UPPER, LIKE LOWER, VOICE MODE TYPE, PITCH EG TARGET, MULTI ROUTING, SELECT NOISE, SELECT VPM, SELECT USER, SHAPE NOISE, CUTOFF VELOCITY, MOD WHEEL ASSIGN, E.PEDAL ASSIGN, BEND RANGE (+), BEND RANGE (-), VPM ENGINE PARAM1, VPM ENGINE PARAM2, VPM ENGINE PARAM3, VPM ENGINE PARAM4, VPM ENGINE PARAM5, VPM ENGINE PARAM6, USER ENGINE PARAM1, USER ENGINE PARAM2, USER ENGINE PARAM3, USER ENGINE PARAM4, USER ENGINE PARAM5, USER ENGINE PARAM6, USER ENGINE PARAM5 TYPE, USER ENGINE PARAM6 TYPE, USER ENGINE PARAM1 TYPE, USER ENGINE PARAM2 TYPE, USER ENGINE PARAM3 TYPE, USER ENGINE PARAM4 TYPE, SHAPE VPM, SHIFT SHAPE VPM, SHAPE USER, SHIFT SHAPE USER, MOD WHEEL RANGE, LFO KEY SYNC, LFO VOICE SYNC, LFO TARGET OSC, MONO LEGATO, MIDI AFTER TOUCH.
